newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hamaoka No.3 reactor unaffected by fire - Chubu.
newsitem.headline: Hamaoka No.3 reactor unaffected by fire - Chubu.

text.p: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc said on Monday its No.3 nuclear reactor at Hamaoka power plant will emerge from its closure for maintenance in early December as scheduled despite a fire on Saturday.
A short circuit caused a small fire around a switchboard in a building housing the 1.1 million kilowatt boiling water reactor on Saturday afternoon. The fire was brought under control within an hour.
The incident occured about nine hours after the reactor was shut for a scheduled maintenance, which is to last about three months, a spokesman for Chubu Electric said.
The fire has not disrupted maintenance operations, and the reactor will be back on line in early December, he said.
